verdict.rationale: The only first-party SDK-like artifact in the evidence is EBANX.js, a client-side library used for card tokenization and device fingerprinting. Everything else describes direct API integration, hosted checkout, a UI component, or AI integration guidance (Agent Skills, llms.txt), none of which is an SDK. Missing for 10: documented official server-side SDKs in common languages, an SDK reference or installation docs, scope beyond tokenization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
